Inmo Olaya offers you the transfer of a Japanese-style restaurant in Barcelona in Sarrià - Sant Gervasi. Sarrià Sant Gervasi has numerous green areas, excellent schools and a wide range of shops and restaurants. It is well connected to the rest of the city and offers a safe and high quality of life environment, combining tradition and modernity.

Restaurant in operation with 150 m2 and a capacity of 48 people, it is a business with an exclusive and high-quality design, with top quality furniture and a Japanese tavern style design. It is distributed in 3 dining rooms, 2 bathrooms, counter bar, large kitchen and cold preparation kitchen.

It is a business in operation and with loyal customers.

Transfer of €160,000 and current rent of €1,800.
